name: Lee County, IL
findings: Lee County has 142 nonprofit organizations. 62 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 47 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Lee County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Lee County list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 47 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 13 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do social and fraternal organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Education organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 5 education organizations here list public events, compared with about 1 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.
